mission_context.goal: Use OPC to route planning, real platform operation, review, and delivery through a resumable social task flow

working_context.instructions: Operate only within the assigned social node. Prefer real browser/page paths. For write actions, require platform-side success evidence and preserve reusable workflow details only.

must_not: Do not invent API write paths when real page flows are required.
Do not treat a clicked button as final success without platform verification.
Do not expand scope to unrelated platforms or unrelated nodes.
